content.comment_body: Thank you for your assistance. I found a similar visualization solution. One last question: is it possible to control the system via the web from multiple devices at the same time, such as both a PC and a smartphone, or several smartphones? Currently, it only works with one device at a time.

As far as I know, this is not possible. The [product_name] provides only a single communication channel for this function. If multiple users try to connect simultaneously, it typically results in failures.

analysis.insight_summary: The key user experience issue is that the web control feature of the product supports only single-device access at a time, which prevents simultaneous connections from multiple users or devices. Attempts at concurrent access can lead to errors, making the solution unsuitable for multi-user scenarios that are increasingly expected in device management today.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to use the web control interface from several devices at once, allowing flexible and simultaneous access for multiple users.
pain_keywords: inability to control from multiple devices
